items.disposition: III.6 does not define a numerical aggregation of all classification layers; keep ties/unknowns rather than inventing a one-planet classifier.
III.7 uses two-place wording while explicitly listing Sun, Moon and horoscope; retain exact discrepancy.
MC substitution changes the subject to mothers; named triplet recipes inherit the context and should not be detached.
The source itself says it occurs outside its extraordinary-birth endpoint; no reverse inference.
III.8 contains literal human/animal and disability claims. Record, do not modernize into metaphor or deploy as biological/identity inference.
Equal-leg phrase is unexplained by the anonymous commentator; Cardanus's longitude-and-latitude reading is a named later interpretation.
Close succession, superior position and exact referents do not provide a complete numerical algorithm.
Abandonment, rescue/rearing and death are distinct; year/month/day/hour conversion requires an explicit choice not given here.
